title: API Versioning
definition: When making breaking changes to an API (changing the shape of the JSON response, removing fields), you must not break existing mobile apps or frontend clients relying on the old format. You solve this by versioning the API in the URL.

answers.question: Define API Versioning in your own words.
answers.answer: When making breaking changes to an API (changing the shape of the JSON response, removing fields), you must not break existing mobile apps or frontend clients relying on the old format.

answers.question: When should you avoid using API Versioning?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
